verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents public programmatic interfaces: the Storage Write API in both gRPC and REST forms, client SDKs (a Rust SDK in Preview), and official ODBC/JDBC drivers that let applications drive BigQuery features from their own tooling. Together these show an agent or program can operate the product through a documented public API. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the core REST API reference for jobs, queries and dataset management, a fuller list of SDK languages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
